        const localCss = "https://www.etsi.org/wp-content/themes/etsi/css/embed_juicer20.css";

        const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
            for (const mutation of mutations) {
                for (const node of mutation.addedNodes) {
                    if (node.tagName === 'LINK' && node.href && node.href.includes(targetCss)) {
                        node.href = localCss;
                        // console.log('Juicer CSS Redirected to:', localCss);
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        observer.observe(document.head, { childList: true });
    })();
